abide by.example: We have to abide by what the court says.

answer back.example: It is rude to answer back to parents.

answer for.definition: nói thay cho; bảo đảm cho
answer for.example: I can answer for my partner because I know her position on this issue.

ask after.example: Jenny rang earlier and asked after you, so I told her you were fine.

ask around.example: I have no idea, but I'll ask around at work and see if anyone can help.

ask for.example: You will ask for trouble if you go there alone.

ask in.example: You should ask in the guest waiting outside.

ask over.example: They have asked us over for drinks on Friday.

bail up.example: I was late because he bailed me up on the phone and wouldn't shut up.

barge into.definition: xông vào (phòng); ngắt lời (một cách thô lỗ)
barge into.example: They barged into my office without knocking and started talking even though I was on the phone.

be in.example: They are never in; I always get their answerphone.

blank out.definition: quên khuấy; trí nhớ trống rỗng
blank out.example: I was so nervous in the interview that I just blanked out and couldn't answer their questions properly.

board out.definition: Gửi thú cưng ở đâu đó khi bạn đi vắng.
board out.example: We board our dog out with friends when we go abroad.

bottle out.definition: Thiếu can đảm để làm việc gì đó.
bottle out.example: She was going to tell her boss exactly what she thought, but bottled out in the end.

bounce into.example: They have bounced the government into calling an early election.

bring along.example: You can bring your friends along if you like.

call after.definition: Đặt tên theo tên ai đó.
call after.example: She was called Rose after her late grandmother.

call around.example: I called around but she wasn't in.

call for.example: I'll call for a cab right away.

call forth.definition: Làm cho điều gì đó xảy ra.
call forth.example: The protests called forth a strong reaction from the police.

call in.example: I had to call in a mechanic for help.

call on.definition: Yêu cầu ai đó làm gì (đặc biệt là phát biểu trước đám đông).
call on.example: I now call on the other party to give their account of what happened.

call out.definition: Phơi bày hoặc buộc tội ai đó làm sai hoặc kém cỏi.
call out.example: He called them out over awarding contracts to family members.

call up.example: I called him up as soon as I got to a phone to tell him the news.

catch at.example: She caught at my sleeve as I was leaving and said she needed to talk to me.

chat up.example: He spent the whole night chatting her up.

check up.definition: Kiểm tra, thăm khám, kiểm tra tình hình.
check up.example: The doctor asked me to come back next month for a quick check up.

chew over.example: He asked for a few days to chew the matter over before he made a final decision.

cool off.example: We’ll talk to Fred once he cools off and can talk rationally.

crack up.example: You'll have to talk louder- you're cracking up.

crash out.definition: Ngủ lại nhà ai đó vì quá mệt hoặc say.
crash out.example: Dave crashed out at a friend's flat after the end-of-term party.

drill down.definition: Đào sâu tìm kiếm thông tin (trên máy tính).
drill down.example: I really had to drill down to get the answers from the database.

drown out.example: The music drowned out the sound of the phone ringing.

fasten onto.definition: Bám sát ai đó, thường là khi họ không muốn bạn ở cùng.
fasten onto.example: He fastened onto the minister on his visit and asked him repeatedly about the scandal.

fire away.example: What do you want to know? Fire away and I'll tell you.

fool with.definition: Chơi với một thứ nguy hiểm.
fool with.example: Around with one of her friends. Don't fool with that- it could explode.

give in to.definition: Chấp nhận điều gì đó mà mình không thích.
give in to.example: The government says it will not give in to terrorists.

give up on.definition: Mất niềm tin vào ai/cái gì.
give up on.example: I gave up on them when I heard what they were saying about me behind my back.

grow from.definition: Bắt nguồn từ, là kết quả từ.
grow from.example: A lot grew from the peace talks.

hang up on.example: A telesales person called, so I said something rude and hung up on them.

hit it off.definition: Có mối quan hệ tốt ngay từ lần đầu gặp mặt.
hit it off.example: We hit IT off immediately and became firm friends.

hover around.definition: Di chuyển xung quanh một nơi.
hover around.example: She was hovering around to see what we were talking about.

keel over.example: He was going to confront his boss, but keeled over and didn't mention the matter.

load down.example: before the relationship went sour. I was loaded down with all the stuff I had to take there.

loosen up.example: He was very shy at first but has loosened up and is more talkative now.

luck into.definition: Đạt được điều gì do may mắn.
luck into.example: We lucked into getting the answer.

lust after.definition: Bị hấp dẫn về mặt tình dục.
lust after.example: He secretly lusts after his friend’s wife.

make it up to.definition: Cố gắng đền bù vì đã làm sai điều gì.
make it up to.example: He tried to make IT up to her, but she wouldn't speak to him.

man up.definition: Cư xử dũng cảm hoặc có niềm tin.
man up.example: She told her anonymous critics to man up and speak publicly.

marry out.definition: Kết hôn với người khác dân tộc, tôn giáo.
marry out.example: Her parents disowned her and refused to speak to her when she married out.

pass on.definition: Truyền đạt một tin nhắn cho ai đó.
pass on.example: I'll pass the message on when she gets here.

perk up.definition: Cảm thấy khỏe hơn hoặc vui hơn, làm cho ai đó cảm thấy khỏe hơn hoặc vui hơn.
perk up.example: She was ill in bed with flu, but she perked up a bit when some friends dropped by.

pick on.definition: Làm phiền, chọc tức, chỉ trích hoặc chế nhạo ai đó.
pick on.example: My friends always pick on me because I don't sing well.

pin down.definition: Bắt ai đó đưa ra ý kiến, quyết định chắc chắn.
pin down.example: I've asked him to set a date, but he's a hard man to PIN down and won't give a definite answer.

pipe up.example: At first, no one answered, then finally someone piped up.

prattle on.example: Geoff just prattled on instead of giving a straight answer.

reckon on.example: Jeff says we can reckon on there being at least fifty people there tonight.

ring back.example: I phoned and left a message this morning but she still hasn't rung me back.

rub along.definition: Có một mối quan hệ khá tốt.
rub along.example: They're not friends, but we rub along.

rush into.definition: Làm điều gì đó quá nhanh chóng.
rush into.example: They don't want to be rushed into giving an answer and have asked for more time.

scout out.definition: Tìm kiếm một cái gì đó.
scout out.example: The researcher spent months scouting out the answer.

show in.definition: Dẫn ai đó vào phòng làm việc hoặc phòng khác.
show in.example: The secretary showed me in to speak to the manager.

sit over.example: We sat over dinner discussing the plans.

speak out.definition: Nói chuyện cởi mở và tự do.
speak out.example: People are afraid to speak out in oppressive political regimes.

stare down.definition: Nhìn chằm chằm ai đó cho đến khi họ không thể nhìn bạn.
stare down.example: He was angry but I stared him down and he left without saying much.

stem from.example: The trouble stems from their refusal to discuss the matter.

stick down.definition: Viết điều gì đó một cách nhanh chóng hoặc không suy nghĩ về nó.
stick down.example: I couldn't answer the test so I just stuck anything down that I could remember.

tack onto.definition: Thêm hoặc đính kèm một cái gì đó không có kế hoạch vào một cái gì đó.
tack onto.example: I tacked a quick message onto the end of the letter after I'd printed it.

tail away.definition: Trở nên im lặng hoặc không thể nghe thấy.
tail away.example: His voice tailed away when he was speaking about what he'd done wrong.

take down.definition: Ghi chú hoặc ghi chép đầy đủ.
take down.example: The police took down his answers to their questions.

take for.definition: Coi ai là người như thế nào, tưởng nhầm ai là.
take for.example: What do you take me for? I would never betray my friends.

talk around.definition: Nói vòng vo về một vấn đề mà không thực sự giải quyết nó.
talk around.example: They talked around the issue without reaching a conclusion.

talk at.definition: Nói với ai đó mà không cho họ cơ hội trả lời hoặc không lắng nghe họ.
talk at.example: There's no point trying to convince them- they'll just talk at you until you give up.

talk back.definition: Cãi lại người có thẩm quyền.
talk back.example: The teacher was cross because the pupil talked back to her.

talk down.definition: Thuyết phục ai đó đừng nhảy từ trên cao xuống tự tử.
talk down.example: The police tried to talk down the man.

talk down to.definition: Nói theo cách tỏ ra bề trên chứ không phải giao tiếp.
talk down to.example: Down. She's a dreadful teacher and talks down to her students instead of teaching them.

talk into.definition: Thuyết phục ai đó làm gì.
talk into.example: She didn't want to let me go, but I finally managed to talk her into it.

talk out.definition: Thảo luận về một vấn đề để tìm ra giải pháp.
talk out.example: They had a meeting to talk out how people felt.

talk through.definition: Hướng dẫn ai đó qua một vấn đề.
talk through.example: The teacher talked me through the test so I knew what to expect.

talk up.definition: Làm cho một cái gì đó có vẻ quan trọng hoặc có ý nghĩa hơn thực tế.
talk up.example: The government are trying to talk up the effect of their policies.

tell apart.definition: Nhận ra sự khác biệt giữa hai thứ.
tell apart.example: They're identical twins so I cannot tell them apart.

tell off.definition: Trách mắng; nói chuyện một cách tức giận với ai đó về việc họ đã làm sai.
tell off.example: His fiancée told him off for arriving nearly an hour late.

tell on.definition: Tố cáo ai đó với nhà chức trách.
tell on.example: The pupil told on the others for cheating and the teacher failed them.

tie in.definition: Đồng ý, được kết nối hoặc hỗ trợ.
tie in.example: The theory ties in with what the police have been saying.

touch on.example: The talk touched on the issue, but didn't give any new information.

try back.example: I called but they weren't in, so I'll try back later.

tune out.example: I tuned him out because he was talking such rubbish.

write in.definition: Gửi một lá thư cho một đài truyền hình, v.v.
write in.example: They asked viewers to write in with their opinions and suggestions.

zone in on.definition: Chú ý lại sau khi không làm như vậy.
zone in on.example: when things started getting more interesting. I zoned in on what they were saying when they started gossiping.

agree with.example: I feel terrible- that food didn't agree with my stomach.

bang about.definition: đi lại gây tiếng ồn lớn
bang about.example: He's banging about in the kitchen.

bash in.example: The burglars bashed the door in to enter the house.

blare out.example: The music was blaring out and I couldn't get to sleep.

blow off.definition: Phớt lờ, không làm việc gì đó.
blow off.example: I blew the homework off and did badly.

board up.definition: Che kín cửa sổ hoặc cửa ra vào bằng gỗ, kim loại...
board up.example: They boarded up all the windows to stop people getting into the empty houses.

box up.definition: Đóng gói đồ vào hộp để di chuyển.
box up.example: At the end of term, I boxed my books up and sent them home.

breeze into.definition: Bước vào một nơi một cách nhanh chóng.
breeze into.example: He breezed into the room and switched the TV on.

care for.example: I don't care for fizzy drinks; I prefer water.

chill out.example: I'm staying at home and chilling out this evening.

choke off.example: These guerilla attacks are choking off our food shipments.

clean off.example: After dinner, I cleaned off the table.

clean out.definition: Làm cho ai đó nhẵn túi.
clean out.example: The holiday cleaned me out- I'm broke till the end of the month.

close out.definition: Kết thúc một việc gì đó.
close out.example: We closed out the meeting early and went home.

coop up.definition: Giam trong một khu vực nhỏ.
coop up.example: They cooped the dog up in a tiny room.

crack down on.example: The police always crack down on drink-driving offences over the Christmas period.

decide upon.example: Jane spent a long time looking at houses before she bought one, but eventually decided upon one near her office.

dine out.example: We dined out because we couldn't be bothered to cook.

double back.example: When he saw the police, he doubled back and went home.

double up.definition: Dùng chung phòng/chỗ ở (do quá đông).
double up.example: We had to double up because we hadn't booked enough rooms.

dress down.example: The staff are allowed to dress down on Fridays.

dress up.example: It's an informal party so there's no need to dress up.

drink up.example: Drink up, please; it's closing time.

drown in.definition: Nhúng ngập, bao phủ quá mức.
drown in.example: They drown the food in sauce.

eat away.definition: Ăn mòn, tàn phá từ từ.
eat away.example: The disease eats the liver away.

eat in.example: We didn't feel like going to a restaurant so we ate in.

eat into.example: We've had to eat into our savings since I lost my job.

eat out.example: We couldn't be bothered to cook so we ate out last night.

eat up.definition: Ngốn mất thứ bạn không muốn bị
eat up.example: The heavy software will eat up your memory.

feed on.definition: Cho ai đó ăn một loại thức ăn cụ thể.
feed on.example: He feeds his cat on dry food.

fend for.definition: Tự lo liệu hoặc tự chăm sóc bản thân.
fend for.example: The children had to fend for themselves after their parents died.

freshen up.definition: Làm mới lại diện mạo của thứ gì đó một cách nhanh chóng.
freshen up.example: The magazine gives you tips on how to freshen up your home cheaply.

front onto.definition: Hướng ra, quay mặt ra (mặt tiền của tòa nhà).
front onto.example: My house fronts onto the main square.

gag for.definition: Rất thèm muốn thứ gì đó.

get about.definition: Được lan truyền, truyền tai nhau.
get about.example: It didn't take long for the news to get about- everyone's talking about it.

get across.definition: Di chuyển cái gì đó từ bên này sang bên kia.
get across.example: How are we going to get these bags across the river?

get across to.definition: Gây ấn tượng tốt, thuyết phục được ai đó.
get across to.example: How can I get across to my audience?

get after.definition: Cằn nhằn hoặc thúc giục ai đó.
get after.example: You should get after them to finish the work.

get along in.example: How are you getting along in the company.

get along with.definition: Hòa thuận, thân thiện với ai đó.
get along with.example: I don't get along with my sister- we have nothing in common.

get around.definition: Có quan hệ tình ái lăng nhăng.
get around.example: He gets around a bit; he's always with some new girlfriend.

get around to.definition: Cuối cùng cũng xoay xở làm được việc gì đó, dành thời gian cho việc gì đó.
get around to.example: It always takes me ages to get around to replying to letters.

get at.definition: Mua chuộc, hăm dọa để tác động đến lời khai hoặc quyết định của ai đó.
get at.example: The gangsters got at the jury, who found them not guilty of all charges despite the evidence presented in court.

get away from.definition: Tránh xa, thoát khỏi (công việc, thói quen).
get away from.example: Work's getting on top of me; I need to get away from it.

get away with.definition: Thành công hoặc làm trót lọt việc gì đó dù không làm đúng cách.
get away with.example: Do you think we could get away with using the cheaper product?

get back.definition: Lấy lại được thứ gì đó.
get back.example: Don't lend him any money; you'll never get it back.

get back at.example: I'll get back at her for landing me in trouble.

get back into.definition: Bắt đầu làm lại việc gì đó sau một thời gian dừng lại.
get back into.example: I am getting back into my Khmer lessons after the summer break.

get back together.definition: Quay lại với nhau (nối lại tình xưa).
get back together.example: We split up a few months ago but got back together last week.

get behind with.example: If you get behind with mortgage payments, you might lose your home.

get by on.definition: Sống dựa vào một khoản tiền nhất định.
get by on.example: It's hard to get by on my salary.

get by with.definition: Xoay xở được với những gì đang có.
get by with.example: We should be able to get by with three PCs, but four would be better.

get down.definition: Làm ai đó buồn bã, chán nản, kiệt sức.
get down.example: The miserable weather in winter really gets me down.

get down on.example: My mother used to get down on us for not doing enough homework.

get down to.definition: Bắt đầu làm việc nghiêm túc, bắt tay vào việc.
get down to.example: I find it extremely difficult to get down to doing any revision for examinations.

get in on.example: The company tried to get in on our market.

get in with.definition: Trở nên thân thiết, lấy lòng.
get in with.example: I tried to get in with them as I thought it would help me at work.

get into.definition: Bắt đầu một thói quen hoặc cách cư xử.
get into.example: It took me ages to get into driving on the left.

get it off.example: They got IT off at the party.

get it off with.definition: Quan hệ tình dục với ai.
get it off with.example: She got IT off with her friend's husband.

get it on.definition: Trở nên hứng thú hoặc phấn khích.
get it on.example: The talk was dull and nobody got IT on.

get it on with.definition: Quan hệ tình dục với ai.
get it on with.example: Did you get IT on with him?

get it together.definition: Sắp xếp cuộc sống vào guồng, chấn chỉnh lại bản thân.
get it together.example: If I don't get IT together, I will never reach my targets.

get it up.example: He couldn't get IT up and felt very embarrassed.

get off on.definition: Thỏa mãn nhờ dùng thuốc/ma túy.
get off on.example: He gets off on crystal meth every night.

get off with.definition: Quan hệ tình dục qua đường với ai.
get off with.example: He got off with her at the party.

get on at.definition: Chỉ trích vô cớ, mắng mỏ.
get on at.example: He's always getting on at me when I haven't done anything wrong.

get on to.example: It took the authorities a long time to get on to the gang.

get on with.definition: Tiếp tục hoặc bắt đầu làm việc gì.
get on with.example: She told us to get on with our work.

get onto.definition: Liên lạc với ai đó để nhờ họ làm việc gì.
get onto.example: We'd better get onto someone to fix this.

get through to.definition: Liên lạc được với ai (đặc biệt qua điện thoại).
get through to.example: I rang but couldn't get through to her.

get to.definition: Bắt đầu thảo luận một chủ đề.
get to.example: We asked him to get to the point, but he just waffled away.

get together.example: We got together in the pub for a drink.

get up to.example: The children are always getting up to some trouble or other.

get used to.definition: Dần quen với cái gì, thích nghi với điều kiện mới.
get used to.example: It took him several months to get used to driving on the left side of the road.

gussy up.definition: Ăn mặc bảnh bao hoặc cải thiện vẻ ngoài của cái gì đó.
gussy up.example: They spent a fortune gussying up the house.

has to.definition: Phải, có bổn phận phải, bắt buộc phải.
has to.example: She has to finish her homework tonight.

head for.definition: Di chuyển hoặc đi về phía.
head for.example: It's getting late- I'm heading for home.

hit on.definition: Nói chuyện với ai đó để cố gắng thu hút họ về mặt tình dục.
hit on.example: She hit on him at the party and they went back to her house.

home in on.example: The government is homing in on benefit fraud.

keep around.definition: Giữ một cái gì đó gần bạn.
keep around.example: I keep a dictionary around when I'm doing my homework.

keep away.definition: Không cho phép ai đó gần một cái gì đó.
keep away.example: Medicines should always be kept away from children.

keep down.example: The food was so horrible that I struggled to keep it down.

kick up.definition: Gây ra rắc rối hoặc đau đớn.
kick up.example: household. My back kicks up when it gets cold.

knock back.definition: Uống cạn nhanh chóng, uống nhiều rượu.
knock back.example: The pub was closing so we knocked our drinks back and left.

knock together.definition: Nối hai căn nhà vốn riêng biệt.
knock together.example: They knocked together two outbuilding and turned them into a home.

lark about.definition: Cư xử ngớ ngẩn, đùa giỡn.
lark about.example: The children made me angry because they were larking about.

lie around.example: Most days he would usually just lie around the house.

live out.definition: Thực hiện hoài bão hay giấc mơ.
live out.example: Many parents try to live out their dreams through their children.

look in.example: I'll look in on my way home.

look in on.example: I'm going to look in on grannie on the way home tonight as she's been a bit unwell recently.

fawn over.definition: Khen ngợi ai đó một cách thái quá để nhận được ân huệ.
fawn over.example: She fawned over the inspectors in the hope that they would give her a good grade.

feed up.definition: Cho ai đó nhiều thức ăn để phục hồi sức khỏe.
feed up.example: She's been ill for a fortnight so we're feeding her up.

fence in.example: They fenced the whole garden in.

fence off.definition: Bao quanh một khu vực để ngăn động vật hoặc người vào.
fence off.example: They fenced off one side of the park to keep dogs out.

fess up.definition: Thú nhận, thừa nhận điều gì đó miễn cưỡng.
fess up.example: The company fessed up after they were exposed in the newspapers.

fiddle around.definition: Thực hiện các chuyển động nhỏ bằng tay.
fiddle around.example: He fiddled around for something in his pockets.

fight it out.definition: Đấu tranh để xem ai thắng, bằng cách tranh cãi hoặc chiến đấu.
fight it out.example: he heard the news of her death. Their fighting IT out to see who will become the next CEO.

fill in for.example: I was away for a few days, so they had to get someone to fill in for me.

fill out.example: I filled out the application form and mailed it.

filter in.definition: Di chuyển vào một làn xe cộ mà không làm các xe khác phải dừng lại.
filter in.example: The slip lane allows traffic to filter in at the junction.

filter out.definition: Loại bỏ những thứ không mong muốn.
filter out.example: It filters out all the impurities and chemicals in tap water so that it tastes better.

finish off.definition: Giết một người hoặc động vật, thường là khi họ đã bị thương.
finish off.example: The animal was badly hurt, so they finished it off to end its suffering.

finish up.definition: Cuối cùng đến một nơi nào đó, thường là không có kế hoạch.
finish up.example: We went out for diner and finished up in a club.

finish with.definition: Dùng xong hoặc không cần nữa.
finish with.example: Can I read the paper when you've finished with it.

fink on.definition: Tiết lộ bí mật về ai đó.
fink on.example: He finked on her to the authorities.

fink out.definition: Không giữ lời hứa, thỏa thuận, v.v.
fink out.example: He said he'd come with us then finked out at the last minute.

firm up.definition: Làm cho mọi thứ rõ ràng hơn trong một cuộc đàm phán hoặc thảo luận.
firm up.example: We need to firm up some aspects of the contract before we sign it.

fish for.definition: Cố gắng lấy thông tin hoặc khiến ai đó nói điều gì.

fish out.definition: Lấy thứ gì đó ra khỏi túi, túi xách, v.v.
fish out.example: She reached into her handbag and fished some coins out.

fit in.definition: Có đủ thời gian hoặc không gian cho việc gì đó.
fit in.example: I didn't have time to fit in another appointment.

fit in with.definition: Xảy ra theo cách cho thấy các kế hoạch hoặc ý tưởng không thay đổi.
fit in with.example: His rudeness yesterday fits in with what I have always thought of his behaviour.

flame out.example: The company flamed out in the recession.

flare up.definition: Khi rắc rối đột nhiên xuất hiện.
flare up.example: The argument flared up when he was rude to them.

flick over.definition: Chuyển kênh truyền hình nhanh chóng.
flick over.example: She flicked over to see if the news had started.

flick through.definition: Chuyển kênh truyền hình liên tục.
flick through.example: I flicked through the channels to see if there was anything worth watching.

flounce off.definition: Bỏ đi khỏi một nơi hoặc bỏ mặc ai đó một cách tức giận.
flounce off.example: He flounced off when they laughed at him.

flounce out.definition: Rời khỏi một nơi một cách tức giận.
flounce out.example: He flounced out when the press started criticising him.

fluff out.definition: Lắc hoặc vỗ một chiếc gối để nó phồng lên.
fluff out.example: She fluffed out the sofa cushions.

fluff up.definition: Lắc hoặc vỗ một chiếc gối để nó phồng lên.
fluff up.example: He fluffed up the pillow before going to bed.

fly about.example: The rumour has been flying about for the past week, but no one has confirmed it.

fly around.example: There are a lot of stories flying around about her past.

fly at.definition: Chỉ trích hoặc la mắng tức giận.
fly at.example: He flew at them for not trying hard enough.

fly by.definition: Khi thời gian dường như trôi nhanh.
fly by.example: As I get older, the years just fly by.

fly into.definition: Thay đổi cảm xúc nhanh chóng.

fold up.definition: Gấp một tờ giấy nhỏ lại.
fold up.example: Darren folded up the letter and put it in an envelope.

follow on from.definition: Là một phần tiếp theo của điều gì đó.
follow on from.example: The film follows on from the original.

fool about.example: They were fooling about and wouldn't settle down.

freak out.definition: Trở nên rất hoảng loạn hoặc tức giận.
freak out.example: She freaked out completely when she didn't get the grades to get into university.

free up.definition: Làm công việc hoặc nhiệm vụ cho ai đó để họ có thời gian rảnh rỗi làm việc khác.
free up.example: If you proofread this text, it will free me up to get on with the next part.

freeze out.definition: Ngăn cản hoặc loại trừ bằng cách đối xử không thân thiện.
freeze out.example: They tried to freeze me out of the conversation.

freeze over.definition: Đóng băng bao phủ trên bề mặt (hồ, sông, ao...).
freeze over.example: The winter was very severe and the lake froze over.

freeze up.definition: Ngừng hoạt động do các bộ phận máy móc bị kẹt.

frighten away.definition: Làm ai đó sợ hãi từ bỏ ý định.
frighten away.example: The strikes frightened many visitors away.

front for.definition: Làm bình phong, đại diện cho ai đó (thường là bao che cho hoạt động phi pháp).
front for.example: The solicitor fronts for a number of criminal gangs.

front out.definition: Đương đầu, đối mặt với sự chỉ trích mà không lùi bước.
front out.example: He had to front out against the critics.

front up.definition: Xuất hiện ở đâu đó trong thời gian ngắn.
front up.example: I hate these occasions, but I'll front up for the first half.

fuel up.example: We stopped to fuel up before the car ran out.

gad about.example: I spent the afternoon gadding about in the West End.

gad around.example: I spent the afternoon gadding around looking for some books.

gang up against.definition: Hùa nhau ức hiếp, bắt nạt.
gang up against.example: They ganged up against me because I wouldn't accept their ideas.

gang up on.definition: Hùa nhau ăn hiếp, bắt nạt.
gang up on.example: They ganged up on him because of the way he spoke.

gear to.definition: Sắp xếp, tổ chức cho một mục đích, đối tượng cụ thể.

ginger up.example: They tried to ginger up the party to stop people leaving.

give back.definition: Mang trở lại thứ gì đó đã mất.
give back.example: Nothing could give me back the way I felt before the scandal.

give it to.definition: Chỉ trích thậm tệ hoặc trừng phạt.
give it to.example: They really gave IT to me for forgetting to turn up.

give it up for.example: Please give IT up for our next guest.

give it up to.example: Please give IT up to our next guest.

give over.example: They were making a lot of noise so I told them to give over.

give rise to.definition: Làm nảy sinh, gây ra, dẫn đến kết quả gì.
give rise to.example: Unclear communication can easily give rise to serious misunderstandings.

give way to.definition: Bị thay thế bởi thứ tốt hơn/hiện đại hơn.
give way to.example: Cottage industries gave way to the big companies.

gnaw at.definition: Làm ai dằn vặt, lo lắng.
gnaw at.example: I know it was wrong and guilt has gnawed at me ever since I did it.

gnaw away at.example: Their behaviour gnawed away at our trust in them.

goof around.example: We spent the weekend goofing around.

goof off.example: We goofed off for the afternoon to watch the match.

grasp at.definition: Cố gắng nắm lấy thứ gì đó thật nhanh.
grasp at.example: He grasped at the rail when he fell.

grass up.example: She didn't to grass them up, even though they'd been bullying her badly.

grind on.example: He was still grinding on about football when we left.

grind out.definition: Sản xuất hoặc làm ra thứ gì đó một cách khó khăn.
grind out.example: I find it very hard to grind out an original essay every week.

grow away from.definition: Trở nên ít thân thiện hơn.
grow away from.example: I have grown away from many of the people I grew up with.

grow back.example: Nails grow back quickly after you cut them.

grow into.definition: Trưởng thành hoặc thay đổi thành.
grow into.example: She's has grown into a lovely person.

grow out.definition: Để tóc tự nhiên mọc lại để loại bỏ kiểu cũ.
grow out.example: I'm letting the perm grow out.

grow to.definition: Dần dần làm việc gì đó.
grow to.example: We grew to like the neighbourhood.

gulp down.definition: Uống ừng ực, nuốt ừng ực.
gulp down.example: After the long run in the hot sun, he gulped down a whole bottle of cold water.

hack around.example: Stop wasting your time and don't hack around anymore.

hack off.example: He hacks me off with his endless complaining.

hack up.definition: Chặt hoặc cắt thành những mảnh nhỏ.
hack up.example: They hacked the table up and burnt it.

hammer out.definition: Đàm phán và đi đến một thỏa thuận.
hammer out.example: They hammered out their differences and got the contract signed.

hang back.definition: Không tiến lên để tránh làm gì đó, chần chừ.
hang back.example: When they raced towards the entrance, I hung back till it was less crowded.

hang back from.definition: Trì hoãn hoặc tránh làm gì đó.
hang back from.example: They were hanging back from making the final decision.

hang it up.example: I’m getting too old for this- I’m going to hang IT up starting next month.

hang on.example: Please hang on for a minute while I check.

hang onto.example: I hung onto my old records even though I never played them.

hang out.definition: Dành thời gian giao lưu xã hội.
hang out.example: He hangs out in the pub The Monarch; he's there most nights.

hang out for.definition: Chờ đợi hoặc từ chối làm gì đó cho đến khi nhận được những gì mong muốn.
hang out for.example: She's hanging out for a big raise.

hang with.example: He has been hanging with them for a few months.

hanker after.definition: Thèm muốn điều gì đó rất nhiều, đặc biệt là khi bạn không nên muốn hoặc không thể có được nó.
hanker after.example: I'm supposed to be on a diet and I can't stop hankering after some chocolate.

hanker for.definition: Thèm muốn điều gì đó rất nhiều, đặc biệt là khi bạn không nên muốn hoặc không thể có được nó.
hanker for.example: I have always hankered for a soft- top car.

harp on.definition: Nói đi nói lại về một vấn đề.
harp on.example: I was late twice last week and my boss keeps harping on about it.

hate on.definition: Ghen tị, lạm dụng hoặc thù ghét ai đó.
hate on.example: She hates on people who disagree with her ideas.

have against.definition: Không thích, không đồng ý hoặc có ác cảm (Thường là tiêu cực).
have against.example: I have nothing against their proposals.

have around.definition: Tiếp đãi ai đó ở nhà của bạn.
have around.example: I had the neighbours around for dinner last night.

have in.definition: Tiếp đãi mọi người tại nhà.
have in.example: We had them in last night for dinner.

have it away.definition: Quan hệ tình dục với ai đó, đặc biệt là quan hệ tình dục thông thường.
have it away.example: She had IT away with him last Friday.

have it in for.example: He has had IT in for me since I beat him last year.

have it off.example: They had IT off after the party.

have off.example: I had a couple of days off last week to relax.

have over.example: Shall we have them over for dinner?

have up.example: They had him up for armed robbery.

head off.definition: Ngăn chặn ai đó hoặc buộc họ phải chuyển hướng.
head off.example: The sheriff and his men headed the bandits off at the pass.

head out.example: We're heading out at seven, so don't be late.

head up.example: He's heading up the steering committee.

hear about.example: Have you heard about the company takeover?

hear out.definition: Lắng nghe mọi điều ai đó phải nói.
hear out.example: I heard them out before I commented.

heat up.example: He heated the soup up in the microwave.

help out.example: She really helped me out when I was going through my divorce.

hit back.example: The president hit back at her critics in a speech last night.

hit it off with.definition: Thích ai đó ngay từ lần đầu gặp mặt.
hit it off with.example: I hit IT off with her immediately.

hit out at.definition: Đáp trả lại lời chỉ trích một cách tức giận.
hit out at.example: The government hit out at the media for their negativity.

hit up on.example: He's been hitting up on heroin for years.

hit upon.definition: Cố gắng thu hút ai đó về mặt tình dục.
hit upon.example: He tried to hit upon her at the pub.

hit with.definition: Làm ai đó ngạc nhiên với thông tin hoặc tin tức nào đó.
hit with.example: He hit me with the details of their demands.

hive off.definition: Tách một phần của công ty hoặc dịch vụ, thường bằng cách bán nó.
hive off.example: They hived off the retail operations.

hold against.definition: Có ác cảm với ai đó, hoặc thiếu tôn trọng.
hold against.example: He was very rude, but I won't hold it against him.

hold back from.definition: Không cho phép bản thân làm điều gì đó.
hold back from.example: I had to hold back from losing my temper with them.

hold down.definition: Ngăn ai đó hoặc cái gì đó di chuyển.
hold down.example: It took four of us to hold him down and stop the fight.

hold off.definition: Ngăn chặn ai đó tấn công hoặc đánh đập bạn.
hold off.example: Chelsea couldn't hold their opponents off and lost the game.

hold out for.definition: Đợi chờ một điều gì đó tốt hơn hoặc từ chối một điều gì đó bây giờ vì một điều gì đó tốt hơn trong tương lai.
hold out for.example: We are holding out for a much better deal than the one offered.

hold over.definition: Tiếp tục làm việc gì đó lâu hơn dự định.
hold over.example: It has been so successful that they have held it over for another fortnight.

hone in on.example: The team will hone in on the main target.

hook into.definition: Thuyết phục ai đó làm điều gì đó họ không muốn làm.
hook into.example: She hooked them into coming after all.

hook up.example: We hooked up at the conference.

hose down.definition: Đầu tư mạnh mẽ vào hoặc ném nhiều tiền vào một thứ gì đó.
hose down.example: They have hosed down an obscure start-up up with capital.

hound out.definition: Buộc ai đó phải rời khỏi một nơi, một công việc, một vị trí, v.v..
hound out.example: The press hounded the minister out after the scandal broke.

hunker down.definition: Định cư ở một nơi thoải mái nhất có thể để ở lại đó.
hunker down.example: The troops hunkered down in the building.

hunt out.definition: Tìm kiếm cho đến khi bạn tìm thấy một cái gì đó.
hunt out.example: It took me ages to hunt out the photos.

hunt up.definition: Tìm kiếm và cố gắng tìm ra một cái gì đó.
hunt up.example: He hunted up a copy the book in the British library.

hurry up.example: Hurry up, or we will miss the beginning of the movie!

hush up.definition: Cố gắng giữ một điều gì đó tồi tệ không được biết đến rộng rãi.
hush up.example: The company tried to hush up the scandal, but it still got into the newspapers.

jack around.definition: Gây rắc rối cho ai đó, không giữ lời hứa.
jack around.example: Don't listen to him- he always jacks people around.

jack in.example: I jacked my job in because my boss refused to give me a raise.

jazz up.definition: Làm cho một cái gì đó thú vị hoặc hấp dẫn hơn.
jazz up.example: The show was getting stale so they jazzed it up with some new scenes.

jerk around.definition: Gây ra rắc rối cho ai đó, đối xử tệ với ai đó.
jerk around.example: He was jerking us around and wouldn't give us the facts.

jump at.definition: Chấp nhận một cách háo hức.
jump at.example: I'd jump at the chance to go and live in Japan.

jump in.definition: Tham gia vào một cuộc trò chuyện.
jump in.example: He jumped in and told them exactly what he thought.

jump off.definition: Bắt đầu nhanh chóng, thường là tốt.
jump off.example: The ipo jumped off on the first day.

keep at.definition: Tiếp tục với một cái gì đó khó khăn.
keep at.example: She found the course hard but she kept at it and completed it successfully.

keep from.definition: Kiểm soát bản thân, kiềm chế.
keep from.example: I couldn't keep from arguing with her.

keep on.example: He kept on trying and succeeded in the end.

keep up at.example: directly? Learning a language is difficult, but if you keep up at it, you'll succeed in the end.

key in on.definition: Tập trung sự chú ý vào, chọn ra.
key in on.example: They keyed in on the person they believed had done it.

key on.definition: Mục tiêu, tập trung vào (thể thao).
key on.example: We will key on the opposing team's lack of skills on defense.

key to.definition: Lập kế hoạch để phù hợp hoặc thích nghi với mọi người hoặc các tình huống.
key to.example: Promotions are keyed to people's abilities.

key up.definition: Làm ai đó phấn khích hoặc lo lắng.
key up.example: The noise got us keyed up.

kick around with.example: I used to kick around with them, but haven't seen them for a while.

kick back.definition: Trả tiền cho ai đó một cách bất hợp pháp như một phần của giá cả.
kick back.example: I had to kick ten percent back to the government official to get the contract.

kick out.example: They had to kick out the rude guest immediately.

kill off.definition: Giảm thiểu hoặc tiêu diệt một quần thể do săn bắt, ô nhiễm, phát triển, v.v..
kill off.example: There used to be a lot of wolves around here, but most of them have been killed off.

kip down on.definition: Ngủ trên một thứ gì đó không phải là giường.
kip down on.example: There were so many of us that we had to kip down on the floor.

kiss off.definition: Coi điều gì đó là không quan trọng hoặc kém cỏi.

kiss up to.definition: Cố gắng lấy lòng ai đó.
kiss up to.example: He's a creep and is always kissing up to the director.

knock about.example: He knocked his brother about after they argued.

knock down.definition: Tông và làm ai đó bị thương.
knock down.example: The car knocked her down and she broke her arm.

knock off.definition: Sản xuất hoặc tạo ra thứ gì đó nhanh chóng.
knock off.example: I knocked the essay off in an hour.

knock out.example: They're knocking hundreds out a day in the sales.

knock up.definition: Chơi khởi động trước một trận đấu.
knock up.example: The teams knocked up for a few minutes before the final.

land in.definition: Khiến ai đó gặp rắc rối.
land in.example: He landed me in it when he told them what I had done wrong.

land up in.definition: Đến hoặc kết thúc chuyến đi ở một nơi thường không có kế hoạch trước.
land up in.example: We set out for Manchester, but landed up in Liverpool.

land with.definition: Gây rắc rối cho ai đó.
land with.example: He landed me with the job of proofreading the whole thing.

large it up.definition: Vui chơi hết mình khi say xỉn.
large it up.example: They were larging IT up in the rave.

lash down.definition: Buộc chặt cái gì đó bằng dây thừng.
lash down.example: We lashed the tarpaulin down to stop the wind blowing it away.

lash into.definition: Chỉ trích ai đó mạnh mẽ.
lash into.example: He lashed into them for messing thins up.

lash out.definition: Tiêu nhiều tiền vào đồ xa xỉ.
lash out.example: I lashed out in the sales last week.

lash out against.definition: Chỉ trích điều gì đó mạnh mẽ.
lash out against.example: The press has lashed out against the policy.

lash out at.definition: Bất ngờ đánh ai đó hoặc cố gắng đánh họ.
lash out at.example: He lashed out at me when I laughed at him.

latch on.definition: Hiểu ra, thường là sau một thời gian dài.
latch on.example: They were lying, but it took her ages to latch on.

latch onto.definition: Nhận ra rằng điều gì đó là tốt hoặc có lợi.
latch onto.example: Oil companies have latched onto environmental ideas.

lay off.example: The hotel laid off twenty staff because tourist numbers were down.

lay on.example: They laid on a buffet lunch at the conference.

lay out.example: They laid out thousands of pounds on their wedding reception.

lead on.definition: Gieo rắc hy vọng hão huyền.
lead on.example: She LED him on about her desire to get married.

lean on.definition: Gây áp lực lên ai đó để họ làm theo ý mình.
lean on.example: The government has denied leaning on the Attorney General to get his approval of the war.

leap at.definition: Chớp lấy cơ hội một cách nhiệt tình.
leap at.example: He leaped at the chance to visit.

leap out at.definition: Rất dễ nhận thấy, đập vào mắt.
leap out at.example: The bright red sign will leap out at you.

let down.definition: Làm thất vọng, không giữ đúng hẹn.
let down.example: She failed to turn up and I felt badly let down.

let on.example: I didn't mean to let on about the party; I just said it without thinking.

level off.definition: Giữ thăng bằng độ cao (máy bay).
level off.example: The pilot leveled off at 5,000 meters.
